tasks.sample: Begin with a warm up on the treadmill.
Use the weights for strength training exercises.
You can adjust the bench for support during your workouts.
Do stretching exercises on the mat to prevent injury.
Wipe down equipment after use to maintain good hygiene.
Please read and follow the instructions for each machine carefully to avoid injury.
Take breaks as needed, and be sure to stay hydrated to obtain the best results.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for participating. Today, I'd like to ask you about your hobbies and free time activities. [2-second pause] What kind of activities do you enjoy doing in your free time?
(Interviewer) Great. Do you prefer spending your free time alone or with others? Why?
(Interviewer) Interesting. Some people believe that having hobbies can significantly improve one's mental health. Do you agree or disagree? Why?

(Interviewer) Good points. I just have one more question. In the future, do you think people will have more or less free time for hobbies and leisure activities? What factors do you think will influence this?
